basis: Assessment of saved source captures and the integrated research heads, not new independent source retrieval or fieldwork.
recommended_sequence: Draft Enduri and Poda pitha, with a bounded Chhena Poda enrichment.
Prepare a carefully scoped Paraja reading feature and Six Acres edition note.
Develop Debrigarh only after local reporting, permissions and evidence gaps are addressed.
reason: Draftable evidence is not a completed illustrated, source-reviewed page. Each brief retains its media and editorial gates.

briefs.subject: Enduri pitha
briefs.working_title: A story inside a turmeric leaf
briefs.opening_direction: Begin with the leaf being opened; let the reader discover the food before introducing the festival and the documented preparation. This is a proposed narrative scene, not an observed household visit.
outline: A close-up reveal of a wrapped pitha.
Prathamastami association attributed to Odisha Tourism.
Compare the institutional preparation account with the remembered household variations contributors may offer.
A visitor question: who makes this in your family, and what changes from one kitchen to another?
briefs.evidence_limit: CRRI printed p.19/PDF p.30 supplies a full preparation account. This does not recover the separate unavailable NCHM PDF or establish one universal recipe.
briefs.visual_plan: Find a reusable documentary image of an intact turmeric-leaf parcel and its opened filling. No verified asset selected yet; record photographer, licence and modifications.
before_publication: Review Odia naming and source-specific variants.
Credit the book/compiler; do not present an untested recipe or a current vendor recommendation.

briefs.subject: Poda pitha
briefs.opening_direction: Organize the story around making, waiting, opening and sharing. Use attributed preparations to show that one name can hold several versions.
outline: A cut surface or leaf-wrapped preparation as the opening image.
Raja association, attributed to the institutional overview.
Milk-based, rice-and-jaggery, and rice–black-gram versions in the 2015 book.
Two named regional accounts, with their limits kept clear.
Invite a household memory with contributor credit.
briefs.evidence_limit: Regional accounts are attributed to named speakers in a reported article, not a surveyed map of all coastal or western households.
briefs.visual_plan: Obtain licensed photographs of identified preparations; label the specific version rather than a generic cake. No asset selected yet.
before_publication: Keep measurements/temperatures out until a tested and credited recipe exists.
Review source attribution and Odia terminology.

briefs.subject: Chhena Poda
briefs.working_title: One sweet, more than one way to make it
briefs.opening_direction: Extend the existing photographed story with an attributed comparison of preparation and a clearly contemporary adaptation.
outline: Retain the existing visitor-facing lead and photograph.
Explain the source-described leaf-assisted baking.
Place the chocolate adaptation in its modern contributor context.
Connect readers to Poda pitha without implying the names denote the same food.
briefs.evidence_limit: A contributor recipe hosted by a tourism body is not independent proof of an invention story or temple practice.
briefs.visual_plan: Reuse the existing chhena-poda asset with its CC BY-SA 4.0 credit. A step-by-step process would require additional correctly identified images.
before_publication: Review the proposed update against the existing page to avoid repeating its story.
Keep historic-origin claims attributed and retain the current image provenance.

briefs.subject: Paraja and Gopinath Mohanty
briefs.working_title: Read a place through a novel
briefs.opening_direction: Offer a reading invitation through the relationship between author, novel and Koraput; keep fictional characters distinct from present-day communities.
outline: Begin with a question the reader can carry into the novel.
Connect to the existing Gopinath Mohanty introduction.
Separate the attributed 1945 original, 1987 translation citation and 1997 publisher listing.
Add an original reading prompt and a source-linked edition guide.
briefs.evidence_limit: Do not attach translator or language metadata from the 1987 reference to the 1997 listing without a matching title page. The novel is not a survey of living communities.
briefs.visual_plan: Audit existing author/reading-context asset provenance before reuse; obtain a licensed Koraput contextual photograph. Do not assume a cover image is reusable or stage fiction as documentary evidence.
before_publication: Review literary interpretation with a suitable reader.
Use original commentary; no unlicensed passages or cover reproduction.

briefs.subject: Six Acres and a Third
briefs.working_title: A story of land, and a way of reading power
briefs.opening_direction: Add a compact source-aware reading and edition note to the existing story; preserve its original prompts.
outline: Retain the author connection and reading invitation.
Distinguish the attributed 1902 original chronology from the 2005 English paperback.
Keep translator-name differences as an editorial follow-up, without silently correcting the publisher.
briefs.evidence_limit: Original imprint uninspected; source disagreement on translator initial and author death year must not be harmonised by inference.
briefs.visual_plan: Existing Fakir Mohan portrait is credited CC BY-SA 4.0; keep it as an author portrait, not a book illustration.
before_publication: Compare against current copy; add only useful nonduplicative detail.
Resolve or explicitly bound edition/name discrepancies.

briefs.subject: Debrigarh community tourism
briefs.working_title: The people behind a nature experience
briefs.opening_direction: Follow the work that makes a nature visit possible. Use dated documentary context while seeking permission-based accounts from the people doing that work.
outline: A credited person or activity as the opening, once consent and evidence are available.
What the historical facility record can tell us.
Public recognition as an attributed statement.
Separate current community testimony, visitor arrangements and measured outcomes.
briefs.evidence_limit: Historical facility revenue, statewide programme totals, reported family counts and actual household income are different measures. No growth headline or wage claim is ready.
briefs.visual_plan: Obtain credited local photographs and explicit permission for participant portraits/testimony. No authentic worker image selected and no simulated interview.
before_publication: Obtain dated local access and operations information.
Seek consent-based community perspectives through a separately authorized outreach task.
Reconcile component accounts before any revenue-growth claim; no wildlife-sighting guarantees.

held_topics.subject: Kendrapara Rasabali
held_topics.reason: Original GI account and correction contain an unresolved curdling discrepancy; do not publish one definitive recipe. A qualified story needs a maker/source review and images.

held_topics.subject: Dhenkanal Magji
held_topics.reason: Internal sugar proportions differ in the specification. No tested recipe, nutrition, shelf-life or sales claim is ready.

house_style: Begin with a meaningful image and an original narrative invitation.
Use a few connected sections rather than a stack of facts.
Keep citations and image credits in the end section, with brief in-story qualifications where interpretation depends on them.
Separate remembered practice, published account, editorial scene and verified current visitor information.
English and Odia names require appropriate language review; imagery must not invent historical evidence.

follow_up.note: Two photographed food pages prepared with source credits, discovery and journey integration. Chhena Poda already contained the proposed preparation detail; only useful onward links added. Literary and Debrigarh briefs remain pending, not counted complete.
